A '''city''' was located near the [[Taanab Spaceport]]. In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] unleashed a [[Taanab mutant rancor|mutated rancor]] at the spaceport, planning for it to wreak havoc in the city, allowing them to steal credits and supplies.<ref name="Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>
